Title: General availability: Azure SQL updates for late-March 2024

Body.Content:
In late-March 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  

  • Prepare for planned maintenance events on your Azure SQL Database resources and minimize the impact on your sensitive workloads by enabling advance notifications.
